referenceGradeRationale: Taxonomy and habitat are authoritative (WoRMS, SeaLifeBase). Only one openly licensed photograph is available on Commons, so carapace outline, leg stance and claw geometry are calibrated from general Majoidea/Mithracidae anatomy descriptions rather than measured side/top/front plates; adult size is reconciled between the small field record and aquarium adults.
